author: Bobby Grayson
description: Translator functions changed on wf2/fixtures: render (exit_line codec fallback + new dummy/2), insert_crashes (exhaustive per module, defer clause suppressed), general? (two new tuple-vs-var clauses), whole_alias (now /4, takes fields; called from fallthrough). No other function touched.
title: Known gap left open: translator exhaustiveness is per-tag totality only; clauses that split a Bool/enum field (true/false) are exhaustive to Lean but not to the translator, so the catch-all is emitted and Lean rejects it as redundant. booleans.ex works around it with a second module leaving a tag unhandled. Fix needs a real usefulness check over Lean patterns.
